summary.text: Red River Wheel is Dong clan's Immortal Gu House. Fang Yuan names it when a waterwheel-shaped house rolls out and suppresses molten flame birds with red light.

claims.text: Dong clan obtained the house from a mysterious inheritance. Fang Yuan knows that in his previous life it showed great power and gained huge fame; a house found this way shocks other forces, because a researched Immortal Gu House usually takes a long time and leaks clues. The birds come from Canary Pavilion. A few self-detonate into lava that the red light absorbs, and the light becomes stronger. Dong clan’s Gu Immortals expect the catch to raise the house’s power, especially speed. Central Continent is shocked that the birds are so easily countered; Western Desert rank eights on the field have no information on this shape.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Red River Wheel is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile equipment of Dong clan, not a five-region map seat.

Similar to Fang Yuan’s previous life, Dong clan fields rank seven Red River Wheel against Flesh Whip Immortal, rotating while blazing with red flames. Head-on charging is the fastest method and not usually the strongest; the house uses its own killer move with overwhelming might against Flesh Whip Immortal. The house, at rank seven, can resist rank eight. A crash would leave both sides even and damage the house, but the house can recover by replacing dead Gu, while Flesh Whip Immortal would be physically injured and harder to heal. It is strongest at the front and back, and the sides are the weakest; Jade Toad Castle helps by crashing into Zhang Fei Xiong. Wan Zi Hong’s petals land on the house and its momentum declines. Dong clan Gu Immortals inside treat her as a Western Desert demoness recruited by Heavenly Court. Fallen Flower Hall then breaks her killer move. The walking meat tree and Red River Wheel collide; hundreds of fleshy tentacles are severed, the wheel surface is battered beyond recognition, over three thousand Gu are lost, and Dong clan starts to repair it.

When Chicken Dog Coop cannot hold against Canary Pavilion, Dong clan steers Red River Wheel to help. It rolls forward, red light tangles the bird group like a ribbon, and the molten flame birds are suppressed, captured, and subdued inside the house. Dong clan’s Gu Immortals treat that catch as thanks; the house’s power rises by twenty percent, and Chicken Dog Coop still has to cooperate with it to resist Canary Pavilion.

During the anti-Fang alliance battle a fire path Immortal Gu House like a giant wheel takes in Dong clan’s Dong Zhu and Gong Ming, then starts rolling: Red River Wheel. Inside, Dong Ming treats the clash as payback for Fang clan destroying Dong clan’s treasure moon oasis with a theft path Immortal Gu House. It whips up intense flame and collides with Fallen Flower Hall; the hall shakes, retreats, and falls into a disadvantage as flames stick to it. Red River Wheel can counter that wood path house to a certain extent. Its fire keeps infiltrating, spreading toward Fallen Flower Hall’s core Immortal Gu. Gong Jiao Che then intensifies the flames, and Fang Gong cannot bring Inquiry Dock to help because Wan clan’s Myriad Age Building blocks that path. Fang Di Chang counts Red River Wheel restraining Fallen Flower Hall among the signs that Wan clan came prepared.

Fang Gong leaves Myriad Age Building and charges Red River Wheel. Roof tile breaker forces a rapid retreat while burning flames close in; he sticks to the house in those flames. Dong Ming drives a collision, the house is thrown backwards, and Fang Gong gives chase. Dong Ming names him a rank eight strength path Gu Immortal. Dong Zhu releases molten flame birds; Fang Gong kicks and punches them to a pulp. In ten or so breaths the house is beaten back again and again, its surface crumbled. Dong Ming and Dong Zhu shout together when it is on the verge of destruction, then Red River Wheel shatters completely. The two are sent flying among fragments of the house and corpses of countless Gu worms.

After Fang Gong also destroys Chamber Pot, he is counted as having already destroyed Winding Light Platform, Red River Wheel, and Chamber Pot. Those three houses are all rank seven and can match rank eight battle strength.
